correctness.summary: The longest-cycle and longest-path vertex-set families follow from sharp alternation bounds against a largest part, explicit extremal constructions, and Dirac's theorem in the Hamiltonian regime. Uniform-subset intersection arithmetic then gives the exact spectra and common cores. Definition-level exhaustive checks through order 9 found no discrepancy.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The inspected September 2026 Smith-conjecture paper gives the complete bipartite sharpness example but not the complete-multipartite classification. Full-text searches of the 2024 Gutiérrez--Valqui paper and the 2013 survey found no multipartite treatment, and synonymous web searches found no equivalent exact formula. Residual risk remains from incompletely inspected Hippchen (2008), Kains (2023), and Wu (2026) sources and from older literature using different terminology.

value.summary: The result gives a full structural description, common connectivity-sized core, pairwise intersection spectrum, and exact equality characterization for both Smith's and Hippchen's conjectured bounds across all complete multipartite graphs.

limitations: The theorem is restricted to undirected simple complete multipartite graphs.
Hippchen (2008), Kains (2023), and Wu (2026) were not fully inspected.
Finite verification supports but does not replace the proof.
Cross-model review has not been performed.
